name: Kingroon (Kingroon 3D)
summary: Budget Chinese printer brand (KP3S, KLP1) that also sells a wide house filament catalog. Kingroon does not extrude its own filament: per owner-verified records it is manufactured by Landu in China, and a third-party review source independently characterises Kingroon filament as an OEM brand attached to the printers, corroborating the contract-manufacture pattern without naming Landu. Positioning is firmly budget, with bulk 10kg pricing and occasional batch-to-batch variability reported.

oem_relationships.notes: Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md. Corroborated indirectly by filamentcheatsheet.com, which describes Kingroon filament as 'an OEM brand from Kingroon printers' without naming the specific OEM.

product_lines.name: Rainbow-Silk Multicolor
product_lines.notes: Silk PLA in a rainbow/gradient colour transition

product_lines.name: PLA-CF
product_lines.notes: PLA + carbon fibre; sold in the 2KG Carbon Fiber Black bundle

product_lines.name: ABS-CF
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled ABS listed in the carbon-fibre bundle; catalog has abs-gf and asa-cf but no abs-cf - reported as a gap

product_lines.name: TPU 95A
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A TPU, durometer confirmed on the product listing

product_lines.name: PA-CF
product_lines.notes: "Specialty nylon copolymer + high-modulus carbon fibre" with the base grade and CF loading undisclosed; catalog has pa6-cf/pa12-cf/ppa-cf but no generic pa-cf, so not confidently mappable - reported as a gap

additional_notes: Catalog is wider than an earlier pass recorded: PLA (Basic/Plus/Matte/Silk/Rainbow-Silk/Glow/Rapid), PETG, PETG-CF, PLA-CF, ABS, ABS-CF and TPU 95A, plus a PA-CF whose base nylon grade is undisclosed. Roughly $10-18/kg, with bulk 10kg packs around $100. Also sells replacement parts, nozzles, build plates and filament dryers, including Bambu Lab-compatible replacement parts per a Formnext 2025 listing. Rated 'Tier B' (about 4.0/5) by one review aggregator, with occasional batch and diameter variability reported. Founding year and exact HQ city were not confirmed in this pass — a follow-up deep dive is recommended.

provenance.conflicts: Public sourcing on Kingroon's corporate details is thin: founding year and exact HQ city are unconfirmed. The Landu relationship rests on the owner-verified table alone; no public source names Landu directly.
